en.title: The Prestige Returns to IMAX and 70mm for 20th Anniversary
en.summary: Christopher Nolan's intricate magic trick of a film, 'The Prestige,' is coming back to theaters in a spectacular fashion. Prepare for a grand illusion as it hits IMAX and 70mm for the very first time.
en.body:
Get ready to be sawed in half, teleported across the stage, and utterly captivated all over again. **Christopher Nolan**'s brilliant 2006 thriller, **The Prestige**, is set to return to cinemas on January 29, 2027, to celebrate its 20th anniversary. This isn't just any re-release; for the first time ever, audiences will be able to experience the dazzling rivalry between Robert Angier and Alfred Borden on the unparalleled canvas of IMAX and the rich, tactile beauty of 70mm film. This move honors the film's enduring legacy and Nolan's own pioneering work in pushing cinematic presentation boundaries.

## A Trick of the Light, Now on a Grand Scale

**The Prestige**, a labyrinthine tale of obsession, illusion, and sacrifice, has long been a favorite among cinephiles for its complex narrative and stunning visual storytelling. The film follows two stage magicians in late 19th-century London whose intense professional rivalry escalates into a dangerous game of one-upmanship, with devastating personal consequences. Nolan, known for his commitment to practical effects and immersive filmmaking, has continually championed large-format presentations. His recent work, particularly **Oppenheimer**, demonstrated a profound understanding of how IMAX and 70mm can elevate a story, drawing audiences deeper into the world he creates. Now, this same technological reverence is being applied to one of his most intricate and beloved films, promising a viewing experience that will amplify its already potent atmosphere and detail.

## Why This Matters to The Prestige's Devoted Fans

For fans who have dissected every frame of **The Prestige** and debated its myriad twists and turns for two decades, this re-release is more than just a cinematic event; it's an invitation to rediscover the magic. Experiencing the film on IMAX and 70mm will offer a chance to see the meticulous craft and hidden clues within Nolan's direction with newfound clarity. The sheer scale and visual fidelity of these formats are designed to pull you into the heart of the illusion, making the stakes feel even higher and the mysteries even more profound. It’s a testament to the film's lasting power that it warrants such a premium re-release, proving that the allure of **The Prestige** is as strong today as it was upon its initial debut.

## What's Next

Mark your calendars for January 29, 2027. Beyond the IMAX and 70mm presentations, **The Prestige** will also be available in 35mm and Digital 2D formats. This multi-format release ensures that as many fans as possible can witness this anniversary celebration, whether they seek the ultimate premium experience or a classic theatrical showing.
